summary: BGM Group Ltd (filer) closed a private placement on June 8, 2026, issuing 200M Class A ordinary shares at $0.06 per share and warrants for another 200M ordinary shares, raising $12M gross. The transaction was previously disclosed in a May 18, 2026 Form 6-K. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a foreign private issuer's 6-K closing the capital raise; warrants present potential future dilution. This is a capital-return event (issuer equity financing) rather than a routine contract filing. The low price per share ($0.06) suggests distressed or heavily discounted equity issuance; watch for subsequent dilution from warrant exercises and any shareholder reaction.
